root_causes.RC1: No identity anchor - appearance re-derived by LLM every generation
root_causes.RC2: Keyword compression drops the setting, keeps plot words
root_causes.RC3: Template meta-instructions leak into the image prompt

decisions: Anchors resolve visual_anchor -> derive-from-prose-once-and-cache -> none; both fields hand-editable
Insertion happens in StyleMixin.apply_styles - the 140-node generate-visual-asset.json graph stays untouched
In-frame selection by matching character names in the LLM's descriptive prose, capped at 3 for CLIP safety
Seed pinning included but scoped honestly: style consistency only, not per-character identity in txt2img
Changes go in place; upstream-merge-friendly layout explicitly dropped
Reference-image / IP-Adapter path deferred - strongest lever but needs a second backend running

apply_styles runs BEFORE the LLM keywords exist - the Prompt node is built empty. Filtering had to move to GenerationMixin._finalize_prompt. Unit tests missed this because they fed apply_styles a prompt shape the real graph never produces.
Action keywords hold a 35% budget reserve; three derived anchors otherwise consumed the entire 150-token budget and left the image depicting nobody doing anything.
Blocklist cannot ban rendering words the style templates themselves emit, because the pass runs over the whole assembled prompt.
AnchorMixin._derive_anchor needs @set_processing to establish the ActiveAgent context the prompt machinery reads.

constraints.note: Python side is TDD - tests/ has a real pytest suite. Frontend has no runner, so P5 is browser-verified via Playwright.

open_gaps: AC5 (off-screen characters excluded) is unit-tested but never observed live - both characters were named in every verification run, so there was nothing to prune.
AC8 verified for RANDOM mode only (payload correctly omits seed). Per-scene and Fixed modes are unit-tested but were not exercised through the UI.
The keyword blocklist needs ongoing tuning. The LLM reliably names the category of a visual detail rather than the detail: "posture" for "shoulders hunched", "lighting" for "lit from below".

Prompt correctness is not rendering fidelity. Prompts are now stable and setting-anchored, but CyberRealistic PonySemi V5 does not render "deep violet skin" faithfully at cfg 5 - a model/CFG matter, out of this track.
The character Visuals sub-tab (Cover Image / Portrait / Rules) is not URL-addressable, so Playwright has to click through to reach the anchor field.

tests/prompts/test_template_section_validation.py crashes on Windows (read_text without encoding) before it can validate anything - which is masking a real malformed section marker, <|SECTION:TASK> at refine-prompt.jinja2:28.

actuals.suite: 5568 passed; 5 pre-existing failures unrelated to this track (2 Windows-only encoding/strftime, 2 time-ordering flakes, 1 encryption env var)
